notes.title: 2024.10.15 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Update Announcement

We haven’t released any update reports recently. This is because, after a comprehensive evaluation, we found that the current version is far from our expected quality, with significant flaws in resource presentation and level design that cannot be overlooked. Therefore, we have decided to undergo a full reconstruction.

What we've completed so far: 

 Optimization and adjustments of Chapter 1's storyline 
 Redesign of Chapter 1 levels, units, and mechanics 
 Reset of tutorial level TR-0 
 Redesign of character attack effects 
 Complete overhaul of the aggro and targeting system 


What we are currently working on: 
 
 Optimization and adjustments for subsequent storylines 
 Production of Chapter 1 levels 
 Redesign of Chapters 2 and 3 levels, units, and mechanics 
 Optimization of visual effects (character art, UI, lobby modeling, dynamic effects, etc.) 


Our future plans include: 
 
 Design of Chapter 4 in the main storyline 
 New characters 
 Redesign of scenario drills (free levels) 
 New modes and levels 

The new development will take quite some time, as we are prioritizing overall quality over rushing the release of updates.
Thank you to all players for your support and patience.
